messages.subject: MUNGE issue
parts:
Hi all, 

I assume I have made a very silly mistake here. I have the following data frame from the UKB GWAS which I am trying to MUGNE. 

REF ALT P SNP BETA A1_FREQ 1: T C 0.208240 rs545945172 0.15156162 0.09714430 2: A T 0.513737 rs201942322 0.07286005 0.11890400 3: G A 0.663313 rs61769339 0.04904727 0.11189400 4: CA C 0.284118 1:692794_CA_C 0.11587010 0.11264200 5: A G 0.342866 rs12238997 0.09740798 0.11752000 --- 11685410: T C 0.725126 -0.02373547 0.31404600 11685411: C T 0.965853 -0.01769667 0.00816123 11685412: T C 0.726242 -0.03440927 0.12624700 11685413: T C 0.565743 -0.05518930 0.16174400 11685414: A G 0.739242 0.03105283 0.13388100


        files=c(        "C:\\Users\\Benjamin\\Desktop\\UKBpah.txt")
hm3<-"C:/Users/Benjamin/OneDrive - University of Bristol/Documents/Projects/active/clumping/LDSC/eur_w_ld_chr/w_hm3.snplist"#https://www.cog-genomics.org/plink/"eur_w_ld_chr/w_hm3.snplist"
trait.names=c("Rhodes","UKB")
N<-c(160466, 25143) #sample sizes
info.filter=0.9
maf.filter=0.01
GenomicSEM::munge(files=files,hm3=hm3,trait.names=trait.names[1],N=N[1],info.filter=info.filter,maf.filter=maf.filter,column.names=list("SNP"="SNP","A1"="ALT","MAF"="A1_FREQ","effect"="BETA", "A2"="REF","P"="P"))

But, when I use this code I get the following error and I have no idea what is causing it

I had not thought about the file formatting. I've just resaved the input without row names or quotes and tab (rather than comma) separated and it seems to be working now :) 

Thank you very much again!

Benji
